Normal path original begin at same Arduino startup point exactly once; disclose added branch overhead
BootB consume intent before main core1 launch and original USB startup
Descriptor prefix original begin only once with PortInit suppressed only in Preparing phase
Task and FlushCDC calls blocked cold prestart and failed phases
Validate final 2E8A:1092 CDC-only composition before port start because begin returns unconditional true
No descriptor clear after identity finalization
Start port exactly once without second begin
No warm-reset helper route or persistent intent
Keep cold recovery gate failed/refused with no retry
limits: No silicon or host enumeration acceptance by source
Intent scratch/reset semantics require separate specialist audit

Normal wrappers add bounded overhead although call order/count preserved
